title: Evidence guides every decision
content: Data, validated methods, and constructive peer review shape our conclusions. When the evidence changes, so do our plans.

title: Curiosity is key
content: We choose questions that spark excitement *and* move the field. Weekly progress might be incremental, but the arc should stay energising.

title: Everyone is welcome
content: Respect is non-negotiable; ideas stand on their own merits. Everyone gets room to contribute and to be heard.

title: Collaboration comes with accountability
content: Shared projects mean shared credit, clear updates, and transparent ownership of next steps.

title: Reproducibility is mandatory
content: We document what we do, clean our data and code, and share when policy and consent allow. If someone else cannot repeat it, it is not finished yet.
